name: create-master-plan
description: Step 1 of a plan-first multi-agent workflow: fork a worktree on a feature branch (indexing it with CodeGraph when the repo already is), pull a ticket from GitHub by default (Jira, Linear and free-form text are adapter profiles), follow its linked items, cited documents and attachments, scan the repo's docs/ exhaustively, detect the tech stack, interview you over a coverage matrix, and write issue.specs plus master-plan.md.
